# Amadeo Ibbdale

Amadeo Ibbdale is a Procurement Review Analyst at Tesstun Works, an AI-driven platform specializing in automating clause extraction and redlining for procurement teams. Joining Tesstun Works in early 2023, Amadeo focuses on streamlining vendor contract compliance workflows by integrating advanced automation with practical procurement oversight.

Amadeo began his career in 2015 at VendorSync Corp., where he played a pivotal role in the development and implementation of the dynamic approval routing system known as Project FluxPath. This innovation reduced vendor contract review times by 40%, allowing procurement teams to handle increased volumes without sacrificing compliance rigor. His expertise in contract lifecycle management and workflow optimization has been instrumental in shaping efficient review processes.

Notable projects at Tesstun Works include the CodexRed initiative, which enhanced clause extraction accuracy by 15% through iterative machine learning model adjustments, and the SwiftReview pilot program, focusing on reducing manual redlining efforts.

Known for his collaborative working style, Amadeo regularly partners with cross-functional teams, including AI engineers, procurement managers, and compliance officers. His approach emphasizes clear communication and iterative feedback to ensure solutions align with both legal standards and operational needs.
